title: NeuroPACT: Efficient Detection of Epileptic Drop Attacks from EEG and EMG Using a Hierarchically Compressed Transformer
summary: NeuroPACT used hierarchical EEG/EMG compression and transformer learning to detect epileptic drop-attack segments; the preprint reports external validation sensitivity 0.9183 and reduced parameters/FLOPs across a multicenter cohort.
